title: Analyste d'affaire SAP
description:

Durée : Jusqu'à avril 2027 – 40 h/semaine / Until April 2027 – 40 hours/week
Lieu : 2 jours en présentiel requis à Montreal / 2 days onsite required in Montreal

Le candidat doit posséder les qualifications suivantes :

  • Connaissance du BPMN (atout) ;
  • Expérience avec les modules d'approvisionnement et logistique de SAP MM-WM-SD (atout) ;
  • Expérience avec SAP IBP ou Analytics Cloud (atout)

title: Device & Field Service Specialist
description:
JOB TITLE: Device & Field Service Specialist (Mechanical Engineer)
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Employee
Target Start Date: July 31, 2026
Travel Requirement: Approximately 50% travel throughout the United States

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Device & Field Service Specialist to join their Service, Production, and Delivery team. This position is based remotely within the United States and is responsible for installing, commissioning, and servicing the client's solutions at customer sites nationwide.

Working closely with customers during solution start-up and service visits, the Device & Field Service Specialist will configure devices to meet operational requirements, provide on-site and remote technical support, and serve as a key point of contact throughout installation, commissioning, and maintenance activities.

The client currently supports customers across the United States, including Tennessee, New York, Washington, Virginia, and Texas.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, proactive, and able to work independently. This is a hands-on role involving installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and servicing of equipment operating in demanding industrial environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, unpack, install, and set up devices at customer sites.
  • Install and commission the client's solutions and engineering devices while ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and schedule adherence.
  • Support the Engineering team during prototype deployments and provide feedback to improve future product designs, functionality, and reliability.
  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair installed solutions to ensure reliable operation and maximize customer value.
  • Configure devices to meet customer operational requirements.
  • Train customer operators on the proper use and operation of installed solutions.
  • Provide on-site and remote technical support as needed.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams by providing feedback for continuous product improvements.
  • Maintain accurate service documentation and installation records.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc.) in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in field service, assembly, technical support, or maintenance of electronic or electromechanical equipment.
  • Electrician certification is a plus.
  • Experience with device programming, control logic, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work hands-on with prototypes, testing, diagnostics, and product improvements.
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and reliability.
  • Excellent English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel approximately 50% throughout the United States.

What We're Looking For

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in industrial environments.
  • Flexible and willing to travel frequently to customer sites.
  • Collaborative team player with a continuous improvement mindset.

Employment Details

  • Full-time, permanent employee position
  • Annual salary: USD $35,000–$135,000, depending on experience and qualifications
  • No planned end date
  • Target start date: July 31, 2026
  • Remote position based in the United States with approximately 50% travel to customer sites nationwide.
